text:
Situation: Calcium gluconate 98 mg/mL 10 mL vials remain in short supply at both campuses. Corvale East holds 866 vials across two lots at 25.1 vials per day, providing 34.5 days on hand. Corvale General holds 382 vials at 13.2 vials per day, providing 28.9 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows calcium gluconate has been posted since 2021-03-24 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been on the list for 67 months.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly one month at each site. The preferred source is Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates plants with last inspections VAI 2023-10-13 and VAI 2023-05-10. Four additional manufacturers are also not on FDA's shortage list today, but their labels name no plant we could verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as primary source; buyer approves.
2. Buyer qualifies B. Braun Medical Inc., Caplin Steriles Limited, Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA, and HF Acquisition Co LLC DBA HealthFirst as secondary sources; buyer approves.
3. Buyer reports weekly inventory and fill rates to P&T committee; P&T committee approves ongoing monitoring plan.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
